# 4. Cultivated-isolate screening and field representation

## 4.1 Isolate taxonomy

```{r isolated_taxonomy}
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(dplyr)
  

  # 1. 读树和注释

  tr <- read.tree(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "consensus_v2.nwk"))
  
  dat1 <- read.delim(
    file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "consensus_v2_idlabel.txt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  table(dat1$genus)
  dat1 <- dat1 %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  
  # 每个tip给一个固定长度的bar
  dat1$abun <- 0.1
  

  # 2. genus分组

  genus_counts <- table(dat1$genus)
  rare_genus <- names(genus_counts[genus_counts < 10])
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- ifelse(dat1$genus %in% rare_genus, "Other genus", dat1$genus)
  
  group_levels <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(dat1$genus_grouped, levels = group_levels)
  

  # 3. 因子顺序

  dat1$medium <- factor(dat1$medium, levels = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"))
  dat1$Temperature <- factor(dat1$Temperature, levels = c("15", "30", "45"))
  dat1$Concentration <- factor(dat1$Concentration, levels = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"))
  dat1$genus <- factor(dat1$genus, levels = c("Arthrobacter","Pseudarthrobacter","Microbacterium","Sinorhizobium","Streptomyces","Other genus"))
  
  genus_order <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  
  dat1$Selected_ring <- ifelse(dat1$Selected == "No", "Not selected", "Selected")
  dat1$Selected_ring <- factor(dat1$Selected_ring, levels = c("Not selected", "Selected"))
  
 
  # 4. 给树分组

  group_list <- split(dat1$ID, dat1$genus_grouped)
  tr2 <- groupOTU(tr, group_list)
  tr2 <- ladderize(tr2)
  
  
  # 5. 配色
  
  genus_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"      = "#D81B60",
    "Pseudarthrobacter" = "#3366CC",
    "Microbacterium"    = "#1B9E77",
    "Sinorhizobium"     = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"      = "#8E44AD",
    "Other genus"            = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  medium_cols <- c(
    "AIA" = "#E64B35",
    "MA"  = "#4DBBD5",
    "R2A" = "#00A087",
    "TSA" = "#3C5488",
    "Nutrient agar"  = "#b39ddb"
  )
  
  temp_cols <- c(
    "15" = "#FDD9A0",
    "30" = "#F39C12",
    "45" = "#D94801"
  )
  
  conc_cols <- c(
    "0.01" = "#C7E9C0",
    "0.1"  = "#74C476",
    "1"    = "#238B45"
  )
  
  selected_cols <- c(
    "Not selected" = "#D9D9D9",
    "Selected"     = "#111111"
  )
  
  # 6. 主树

  p <- ggtree(
    tr2,
    layout = "circular",
    size = 0.22,
    aes(color = group)
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = genus_cols,
      breaks = genus_order,
      limits = genus_order,
      name = "Genus"
    ) +
    geom_treescale(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      fontsize = 5,
      offset = 0.5,
      linesize = 0.8
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  
  p1 <- p +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = medium),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.020,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = medium_cols,
      breaks = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"),
      limits = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"),
      name = "Medium"
    )
  p1

  # 9. ring 2: temperature

  p2 <- p1 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Temperature),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = temp_cols,
      breaks = c("15", "30", "45"),
      limits = c("15", "30", "45"),
      name = "Temperature"
    )
  p2

  # 10. ring 3: concentration

  p3 <- p2 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Concentration),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = conc_cols,
      breaks = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"),
      limits = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"),
      name = "Concentration"
    )
  p3
 
  # 11. ring 4: selected for coculture

  p4 <- p3 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Selected_ring),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.055,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.015
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = selected_cols,
      breaks = c("Selected", "Not selected"),
      limits = c("Selected", "Not selected"),
      name = "Co-culture screen"
    )
  
  p4
  
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "cdhit_16s.tree-update.pdf"),width = 10, height = 10)
  
  #堆叠图展示genus ratio

  ## Sand-incubation-panel
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(dplyr)
  
  
  # 1. read data
 
  dat2 <- read.delim(
    file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "metagenome", "50-culture", "50.cas.txt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  tr <- read.tree(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "metagenome", "50-culture", "16s-50.culture.nwk"))
  
  dat1 <- read.delim(
    file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "metagenome", "50-culture", "16s-culture_idlabel.txt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  dat1 <- dat1 %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  
 
  # 2. genus grouping
  # 规则：
  # - 前面大树已有主genus：保留并沿用原色
  # - 新genus中，出现 >= 3 次：保留并赋新色
  # - 其余并入 Other genus

  major_genus <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces"
  )
  
  genus_counts <- table(dat1$genus)
  
  new_keep_genus <- names(genus_counts)[
    genus_counts >= 3 & !(names(genus_counts) %in% major_genus)
  ]
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- ifelse(
    dat1$genus %in% c(major_genus, new_keep_genus),
    dat1$genus,
    "Other genus"
  )
  

  # 3. color palette
  # 旧颜色保持一致；新增genus给新颜色

  base_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"      = "#D81B60",
    "Pseudarthrobacter" = "#3366CC",
    "Microbacterium"    = "#1B9E77",
    "Sinorhizobium"     = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"      = "#8E44AD"
  )
  
  # 给新出现且 >=3 次的 genus 分配新颜色
  # 可按需要扩充
  extra_pool <- c(
    "#7CAE00",  # olive green
    "#F564E3",  # pink-purple
    "#00BFC4",  # teal
    "#A6761D",  # brown
    "#E7298A",  # magenta
    "#66A61E"   # green
  )
  
  if (length(new_keep_genus) > length(extra_pool)) {
    stop("新增 genus 太多，extra_pool 颜色不够，请补充颜色。")
  }
  
  extra_cols <- setNames(extra_pool[seq_along(new_keep_genus)], new_keep_genus)
  
  genus_cols <- c(
    base_cols,
    extra_cols,
    "Other genus" = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  # legend 顺序：
  # 先前面已有的5个
  # 再新增保留的 genus（按字母排序或按频次都可以）
  # 最后 Other genus
  new_keep_genus <- sort(new_keep_genus)
  
  
  genus_order <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Bacillus_A",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Peribacillus",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(dat1$genus_grouped, levels = genus_order)
  
  
  # 4. significant factor
  
  dat1$significant <- factor(dat1$significant, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  
  sig_cols <- c(
    "No"  = "#D9D9D9",
    "Yes" = "#1B9E77"
  )
  

  # 5. group tree
  
  dat2 <- split(dat1$ID, dat1$genus_grouped)
  tr2  <- groupOTU(tr, dat2)
  
 
  # 6. base tree

  p_base <- ggtree(
    tr2,
    layout = "circular",
    aes(color = group),
    size = 0.58
  ) + geom_treescale(x = 0, y = 0, width = 0.5, fontsize = 6)
  p_base 
  
 
  # 7. labels
 
  p2 <- p_base +
    geom_tiplab2(
      aes(label = label),
      size = 4.8,
      offset = 0.08,
      align = TRUE,
      linetype = "dotted",
      linesize = 0.6,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = genus_cols,
      breaks = genus_order,
      limits = genus_order,
      name = "Genus",
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.4))
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.16, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
    )
  p2

  # 8. outer significant ring
  # significant 仍放最外围
 
  p3 <- p2 +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = significant),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.035,
      offset = 0.28,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.015
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_cols,
      breaks = c("No", "Yes"),
      limits = c("No", "Yes"),
      name = "Priority strains"
    )
  
  p3
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "16s", "50.tree-update.pdf"),width = 8, height = 8)
```

## 4.2 Isolate–MAG genomic overlap

```{r isolate-mag}

#ANI
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)



# 读取数据
df <- read_tsv(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "isolate_MAGs_field", "panelA_input.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 分类
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ANI = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ANI)),
    category = case_when(
      is.na(ANI) ~ "No hit",
      ANI >= 95 ~ "ANI \u2265 95",
      ANI >= 90 & ANI < 95 ~ "90 \u2264 ANI < 95",
      ANI < 90 ~ "ANI < 90"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c("ANI \u2265 95", "90 \u2264 ANI < 95", "ANI < 90", "No hit")
    )
  )

# 统计数量和比例
plot_df <- df2 %>%
  count(category) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label = paste0(n, "\n(", round(percent, 1), "%)")
  )

# 绘图
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = category, y = n)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "#0277bd") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.4, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of isolates"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(p)

# 保存
ggsave(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "isolate_MAGs_field", "PanelA_ANI_overlap_barplot.pdf"),
  p, width = 6, height = 4.6
)


# see the genus seperately
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)


# File paths

iso_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "isolate_MAGs_field", "isolates_genus_count.tsv")
mag_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "isolate_MAGs_field", "fieldMAGs_genus_count.tsv")

# Common settings

top_n <- 10
bar_fill <- "#4C78A8"

make_top_plot <- function(df, total_denominator = NULL, ylab_text = "Percentage", remove_unclassified = FALSE) {
  
  if (remove_unclassified) {
    df <- df %>% filter(genus != "Unclassified")
  }
  
  if (is.null(total_denominator)) {
    total_denominator <- sum(df$n)
  }
  
  df2 <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(),
           genus_plot = if_else(rank <= top_n, genus, "Others")) %>%
    group_by(genus_plot) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / total_denominator * 100) %>%
    arrange(desc(percent))
  
  # Others放最下面
  df2 <- df2 %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = if_else(genus_plot == "Others", "zzz_Others", genus_plot)) %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = fct_reorder(genus_plot, percent)) %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = fct_recode(genus_plot, Others = "zzz_Others"))
  
  p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = genus_plot, y = percent)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = bar_fill) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)), hjust = -0.12, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab_text) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  return(p)
}


# Panel B: isolates

iso_df <- read_tsv(
  iso_file,
  col_names = c("genus", "n"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pB <- make_top_plot(
  df = iso_df,
  total_denominator = sum(iso_df$n),
  ylab_text = "Percentage of isolates",
  remove_unclassified = FALSE
) +
  ggtitle("Isolates")


# Panel C: field MAGs

mag_df <- read_tsv(
  mag_file,
  col_names = c("genus", "n"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 去掉 Unclassified 后再计算百分比
mag_df_classified <- mag_df %>% filter(genus != "Unclassified")
mag_df_classified <- mag_df

pC <- make_top_plot(
  df = mag_df_classified,
  total_denominator = sum(mag_df_classified$n),
  ylab_text = "Percentage of MAGs",
  remove_unclassified = FALSE
) +
  ggtitle("Field MAGs")


# Combine

library(cowplot)

p_combined <- plot_grid(
  pB, pC,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "h",
  axis = "tb"
)

print(p_combined)

# Save

ggsave(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "isolate_MAGs_field", "PanelBC_genus_composition_percent.pdf"),
  p_combined, width = 12, height = 4
)
```

## 4.3 Sterile-sand isolate screening

```{r isolate-screening}

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
  
  mydata <- read.delim(
    file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "50-strains", "ks.all.plot.txt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
  )
  
  mydata$ks <- as.numeric(mydata$ks)
  
  # 只保留 MA / R2A
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    filter(medium %in% c("MA", "R2A"))
  
  # 每个 medium 对应 NC
  nc_map <- c("MA" = "MA-NC", "R2A" = "R2A-NC")
  
  # genus 合并逻辑（和原来一致）
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    mutate(
      genus_plot = case_when(
        genus %in% c("Bacillus_A", "Bacillus_I", "Bacillus") ~ "Bacillus_A",
        genus %in% c("Arthrobacter", "Microbacterium", "Peribacillus",
                     "Streptomyces") ~ genus,
        TRUE ~ "Other genus"
      ),
      genus_plot = factor(
        genus_plot,
        levels = c("Arthrobacter", "Bacillus_A", "Microbacterium",
                   "Peribacillus", "Streptomyces", "Other genus")
      )
    )
  
  # 调色板
  genus_cols <- c(
    Arthrobacter   = "#e41a1c",
    Bacillus_A     = "#377eb8",
    Microbacterium = "#4daf4a",
    Peribacillus   = "#ff7f00",
    Streptomyces   = "#984ea3",
    'Other genus'         = "#999999"
  )
  
  # 逐株 vs 对应 NC 统计
  stat_res <- mydata %>%
    distinct(group, medium, genus_plot) %>%
    filter(!group %in% c("MA-NC", "R2A-NC")) %>%
    mutate(nc_group = nc_map[medium]) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      n_group = sum(mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nc    = sum(mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_group = median(mydata$ks[mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nc    = median(mydata$ks[mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_ks     = median_group - median_nc,
      pct_change   = (median_group - median_nc) / median_nc * 100,
      p_value      = wilcox.test(
        x = mydata$ks[mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium],
        y = mydata$ks[mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium],
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      priority_strain = ifelse(delta_ks < 0 & p_value < 0.1, "Priority", "Other")
    ) %>%
    arrange(medium, delta_ks)
  
  stat_res
  
  # x轴顺序：按各组中位数升序，NC放最后
  order_df <- mydata %>%
    group_by(group, medium) %>%
    summarise(med_ks = median(ks, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(is_nc = group %in% c("MA-NC", "R2A-NC")) %>%
    arrange(medium, is_nc, med_ks)
  
  group_levels <- order_df$group
  
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    mutate(
      group  = factor(group, levels = unique(group_levels)),
      medium = factor(medium, levels = c("MA", "R2A"))
    )
  
  # 给 priority 组准备带星号的标签
  label_df <- stat_res %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = ifelse(priority_strain == "Priority",
                           paste0(group, "*"),
                           group)
    ) %>%
    select(group, medium, group_label)
  
  # 用于替换 x 轴标签
  label_map <- setNames(label_df$group_label, label_df$group)
  
  # NC 自己也保留原名
  label_map["MA-NC"] <- "MA-NC"
  label_map["R2A-NC"] <- "R2A-NC"
  
  # 需要打星号的组
  star_df <- stat_res %>%
    filter(priority_strain == "Priority") %>%
    select(group, medium)
  
  # 给每个组计算星号放置高度：该组最大值 + 一点偏移
  star_pos <- mydata %>%
    group_by(group, medium) %>%
    summarise(
      y = max(ks, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.06,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(star_df, by = c("group", "medium")) %>%
    mutate(label = "*")
  
  star_pos
  
  
  
  p_box2 <- ggplot(mydata, aes(x = group, y = ks, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.62,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85,
      width = 0.045, height = 0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = star_pos,
      aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      # strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      # axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Estimated Ks (m/day)"
    )
  
  p_box2
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "50-strains", "50-ks.boxplot-update.pdf"), width = 10,height = 6)
  
  plot_df <- stat_res %>%
    mutate(
      group = fct_reorder(group, pct_change),
      priority_strain = factor(priority_strain, levels = c("Other", "Priority"))
    )
  
  p_effect <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = pct_change, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = priority_strain), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Other" = 16, "Priority" = 17), name = "Screening result") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      # strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      # axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "% change in estimated Ks vs medium control"
    )
  
  p_effect

  ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "50-strains", "50-ks.boxplot-effect.pdf"), width = 10,height = 6)
  
    
  p_delta <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = delta_ks, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = priority_strain), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Other" = 16, "Priority" = 17), name = "Screening result") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(Delta*" estimated Ks (m/day) vs medium control")
    )
  
  p_delta
```
